_note: Only father_insight is authored. supporting_partner, connecting_with_baby and mission are omitted on purpose so they derive from the matching mother week (partnerCorner + babyDevelopment), which is already written and reviewed for all 37 weeks. See lib/models/father_week_derive.dart. Adding one of those keys here overrides the derivation for that section only.

body.en: Not everything. One. How to swaddle, or what colic actually is, or how a car seat installs. Competence in one small thing beats anxiety about all of it.
body.hi: Sab kuch nahi. Ek. Swaddle kaise karte hain, ya colic asal mein kya hai, ya car seat kaise lagti hai. Ek chhoti cheez mein maharat, sab ki fikr se behtar hai.
